description: Defines the HTMLPurifier_AttrTypes class which manages attribute type definitions and their implementations for HTMLPurifier, including construction, retrieval, and setting of attribute types.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTypes
classes.description: Manages a collection of attribute type definitions and their implementations, providing methods to construct, retrieve, and set attribute types.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the attribute types with default implementations for various attribute types.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the attribute definition object for a given type, optionally handling extra info appended with '#'.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets or replaces the implementation for a specific attribute type.
